notes: Run with `--home /tmp/lum1307/home-bogus` (settings.json: theme=solarized — a name this build cannot resolve).

Documents the other half of the startup contract: a stored theme that does not resolve must be *reported*, not silently swallowed, and must leave the previous palette installed rather than a themeless App.
`probe` rows are post-fix behaviour, so the pre-fix binary reports XFAIL for them instead of failing the run.
caption: LUM-1307 — the unresolvable-theme arm: `settings.json` says `theme: solarized`, which no scheme in this build answers to. Post-fix the startup path says so in the transcript (`theme → not applied`) and keeps the default dark palette, which `/settings` then reports as `dark`. The pre-fix binary says nothing at all and still shows `dark`, so the only thing that changes is whether the user is told. Real binary + real PTY + pyte VT emulator; nothing mocked.
